title: EBS 라디오 입이 트이는 영어 - 3.9 Benefits of Secondhand Trading
vocab:
secondhand trading: 중고거래
in the first place: 애당초
begin with: 애초에
greedy: 탐욕스러운, 욕심 많은
clear out: 청소하다, 처분하다

sentences:
I do a lot of secondhand trading.
It cuts down on waste.
It also makes me think twice before buying anything new.
